title: 2009 HMMT November Guts Problem 35
statement: Call an integer \(n>1\) radical if \(2^{n}-1\) is prime. What is the 20 th smallest radical number? If \(A\) is your answer, and \(S\) is the correct answer, you will get \(\max \left(25\left(1-\frac{|A-S|}{S}\right), 0\right)\) points, rounded to the nearest integer.
